data.name: Rafat
data.gender_notes: Rafat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rafat means 'exalted' or 'lofty' in Arabic and is derived from the root r-f-t, which implies elevation or uplifting. The name Rafat carries the meaning “Exalted, Lofty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rafat usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, lofty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rafat is mentioned in Surah Al-Muddaththir (74:11) of the Quran, where it refers to the exalted nature of Allah's throne.
data.etymology: Rafat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Lofty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
